title: Skyline Showdown
tagline: Two gorillas, a city at dusk and a lot of exploding bananas.
pitch: Two gorillas face off across the rooftops. Pick an angle, feel the wind and lob an exploding banana over the city. Every miss blows a hole in the skyline and teaches you something; the first clean hit brings the house down.
highlights: Learn it in one throw, master it in the wind
Play a friend on one keyboard, or a CPU at four levels
Earth, the Moon, Mars and Jupiter, each with its own gravity
Power-ups on balloons, slow-motion replays, a city you can blow apart

screens.caption: Pull back, read the wind, let it fly.
Every miss leaves its mark on the skyline.
On the Moon, a banana floats for ages.
On Jupiter it drops like a stone.
Play on from dusk into the night.
Or settle it in broad daylight.
